## Problem Being Solved
Is your feature request related to a problem or user pain point? Please describe (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...").

## Proposed Feature
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the interface or API should behave.

## Expected Benefit
Describe why this enhancement is valuable for students or open-source contributors using OpenTask.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or diagrams about the feature request here.
